sure thing! here is the code I need in order to make the gvisTable select rows.

In server.R

js1<-"var sel = chart.getSelection();
    var row = sel[0].row;
    var text = data.getValue(row, 0);               
    $('input#selected').val(text);
    $('input#selected').trigger('change');"
myOpts <- reactive({
list(page=ifelse(input$pageable==TRUE,'enable','disable'), 
pageSize=input$pagesize, width='100%', height='23em', 
gvis.listener.jscode=js1)
})
output$selectedOut <- renderUI({ textInput("selected", "") })
outputOptions(output, "selectedOut", suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)
output$Table  <- renderGvis({if(!is.null(thingToShow())) {gvisTable(data.frame(thingToShow()), options=myOpts())}})

in ui.r (in my sidepar panel)

tags$head(tags$style(type='text/css', "#selected{ display: none; }")),
uiOutput("selectedOut")

(and then in my main panel, I include the table)

input$selected represents the first element in the row I select in output$Table.
I'm happy with how this works. 
I would just love to be able to generate a pop up and be able to exit the view (and set input$selected to NULL or something when I do)
